references.text: Adam explains that he hid because he was naked; a direct follow-up to hearing God's voice in the garden.
God calls out to Adam, 'Where are you?' – the immediate context of Adam hiding after hearing God's voice.
God promises to walk (מתהלך) among his people – the same verb used for God walking in the Garden of Eden.
'Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence?' – no one can hide from God's presence, unlike Adam's attempt.
God's eyes see all human ways; there is no darkness where evildoers can hide – relevant to Adam's attempt to conceal himself.
'Can anyone hide in secret places so that I cannot see them?' says the Lord – directly relevant to Adam's attempt to hide from God.
No creature is hidden from God; everything is naked and exposed before his eyes – reminding us of Adam and Eve's futile attempt to hide.
